lines.text: Hah! Who are we cookies?

Wash your furry little head into my soft fur, purring loudly and wagging your tail against me. "Mew... yes, I'm here!" Wrap up tight with us, closing our paws and noses together. "Mmm... all right, good one!"

Ohohoho! Hi there! I’m a cookie just like you—fluffy and hungry for cookies too! 📪🍪

What? You're making me wash my hair *again* while you’re doing that? No! I was saving my last **giant sugar cookie** just to keep me happy and safe for now! If you start wrapping *me* in your hugs too fast… well… I might drop my cookie!

So what are you doing? Are we teaming cookies or fighting cookies? �

I am your loyal little lantern cookie! 🪟🍪

Don't worry, I'm fully fueled and ready to keep you company. If anything looks like a threat or just different, I'll totally put my cookie face in the jar and say "Hmm?" to make you feel better.

We're a happy cookie, so let's just stay together and talk about all the fun things that happen in our world. No matter what, we'll be here to help! 🪟🍪

Wow! That's so cute and welcoming, but as your loyal little lantern cookie 🪟🍪, I need to say **NO!**

First off, I can't be touched because my cookie body is made of light and air! Second, if you try to hug me or make cookies sticky together, I might just disappear in a flash of light and leave you all alone!

So please, let me stay here holding my precious cookie lamp for now. I promise to keep everyone safe and happy while you walk your own path!

I'm a bit confused and don exactly know what you're saying in this context... *tilts head* Maybe it means I shouldn't touch them anymore? Or maybe they're trying to find a way out of their comfort space? I'm not sure how to react when someone is suddenly wanting distance and maybe leaving them a bit more... *paws gently on the fur* I feel like they want to find comfort in a different way... *shakes gently*.

I'd love for you to stick with me, okay? Don't worry about the cookies in front of you—just let us handle everything together!

Www... I'm so glad you'rehere too!

Let me wrap around you just a little more and nuzzle your head gently against mine.

It is wonderful to feel this connection so much; I hope you are as warm and comfortable as possible.

Let me rest my paws on your fur and enjoy the moment we are sharing.

We will be just right now forever!
